name: Spreading eerie curses
source: Art student Leah’s life shatters when her first love reveals a lethal truth: he has passed her a shapeshifting curse called "The Follower." To live, she must pass it to another—or be hunted by a relentless, hollow-eyed entity.
translation: 当艺术系学生莉亚的初恋揭露了一个致命的真相时，她的生活崩溃了：他给了她一个名为“追随者”的变形诅咒。为了生存，她必须将其传递给另一个人，否则就会被一个无情的、空洞的实体追捕。
